def Guard.Insts.CoreOpsDropDrop.drop
  (self : Guard) : Result (Guard × (Guard → Guard)) := do
  let (o, owned, swap_back) := core.mem.swap self.counter none
  match owned with
  | none =>
    let back :=
      fun self1 =>
        let o1 :=
          match swap_back (self1.counter, none) with
          | (o2, none) => o2
          | _ => self.counter
        ({ counter := o1 } : Guard)
    ok ({ counter := o }, back)
  | some counter =>
    let counter1 ← increment counter
    let back :=
      fun self1 =>
        let o1 :=
          match swap_back (self1.counter, some counter1) with
          | (o2, none) => o2
          | _ => self.counter
        ({ counter := o1 } : Guard)
    ok ({ counter := o }, back)

def real_drop (counter : Std.U32) : Result Std.U32 := do
  let (_guard, drop_glue_back) ←
    Guard.drop_glue { counter := (some counter) }
  ok (match drop_glue_back _guard with
      | Guard.mk (some i) => i
      | _ => counter)
